## User Story

**As a** Jarvis user  
**I want** shell and web lookup tools  
**So that** the agent can run commands (with guardrails) and fetch external info

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `run_shell_command(cmd)` tool with confirmation guard
- [ ] `wikipedia_search(query)` tool
- [ ] `get_weather(location)` tool
- [ ] All tools have docstrings and type hints

## Story Points

**Estimate:** 5
